label: Performance Review Summarizer
description: Aggregates 360-degree feedback from multiple reviewers into a coherent summary. Identifies themes, balances perspectives, and structures development recommendations.

guidedInputs.label: 360-degree feedback responses
guidedInputs.description: Paste the feedback from multiple reviewers. Label each reviewer by role (Manager, Peer 1, Peer 2, Direct Report 1, etc.) — not by name.
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Manager: 'Strong technical skills but struggles to delegate — tends to do everything herself rather than develop the team. Excellent client management, clients specifically request to work with her.'
Peer 1: 'Very responsive and collaborative. Sometimes overpromises to clients and then the team has to deliver an unrealistic scope.'
Direct Report 1: 'Great mentor and very clear on priorities. Can be impatient when work is not done to her standard.'

guidedInputs.label: Employee role and level
guidedInputs.description: Brief description of the role and level — helps calibrate expectations and development recommendations.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Senior Compliance Manager, 3 years in role, manages a team of 4 analysts, client-facing, aspiring to Director level.

guidedInputs.label: Employee self-assessment (if available)
guidedInputs.description: Paste the employee's own performance self-assessment. This will be compared with reviewer feedback.
